## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-*juan* late-Míng companion-commentary by **Ǒuyì Zhìxù** 蕅益智旭 on his own *Jiàoguān gāngzōng* ([KR6d0188](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0188), T1939), providing additional interpretive notes on contested or obscure points in the main treatise. Together with the *Gāngzōng* itself, it constitutes Zhìxù's two-text apparatus on the Tiāntái doctrinal-meditative system.

**Abstract**

Zhìxù's *Shìyì* belongs together with the *Gāngzōng* as a coordinated two-text pedagogical apparatus, with the *Gāngzōng* providing the main systematic exposition and the *Shìyì* providing supplementary interpretive notes on selected passages. The composition is bracketed with the *Gāngzōng* in Zhìxù's mature productive period c. 1641–1655.
